rules.text: One suit of armor and one Shield at a time. Without armor training: Disadvantage on Strength/Dexterity D20 Tests and no spellcasting. A listed Strength requirement reduces Speed by 10 feet unless met; listed Stealth Disadvantage applies while worn.

definition.name: Breastplate
definition.description: This armor consists of a fitted metal chest piece worn with supple leather. Although it leaves the legs and arms relatively unprotected, this armor provides good protection for the wearer's vital organs while leaving the wearer relatively unencumbered.
